in_sanskrit.name: Akshan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intelligent, Wise, Perceiver
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Akshan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Akshan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akshana’ which means 'that which is perceived' or 'intelligent'. It is believed that the one bearing this name is a perceiver of truth and wisdom.
